sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. C.R. Swain, Aga
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
12.03.2025 Order No.
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R Case No.12 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Barbil, arising out of Cyber Crime & Economic Offences Police Station Keonjhar Case No.01 of 2025 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 419/420 IPC read with Section 66D of I.T Act.

entities.text: Cyber Crime & Economic Offences Police Station Keonjhar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the allegation is an offshoot of non-adherence to the norms of the agreement at Annexure-2 and the nature of accusation is primarily civil in nature and the same is being given the colour of criminality and the FIR has been instituted.
4. It is further submitted that the Petitioner is the first offender.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer and submits that the Petitioner ought not to be released on pre-arrest bail since the investigation is at a nascent stage.

6. Taking into account the nature of allegations, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedents.
If it comes to fore that the Petitioner has any criminal antecedents, this order shall not be given effect to.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the allegation is an offshoot of non-adherence to the norms of the agreement at Annexure-2 and the nature of accusation is primarily civil in nature and the same is being given the colour of criminality and the FIR has been instituted.
4. It is further submitted that the Petitioner is the first offender.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer and submits that the Petitioner ought not to be released on pre-arrest bail since the investigation is at a nascent stage.
opennyai_summary.decision:
6. Taking into account the nature of allegations, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedents.
If it comes to fore that the Petitioner has any criminal antecedents, this order shall not be given effect to.
7. Before releasing learned Court in seisin shall also verify as to whether the order of this Court has been assailed before the Apex Court and if so, the result thereof.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
